item_short_desc: Stay ready for action with Rothco’s Quick Draw Tactical Vest, designed for efficiency and comfort. The left-side universal pistol holder ensures a quick right-hand draw and accommodates most full-size handguns. 3 rifle magazine pouches and a triple pistol magazine pouch provide ample storage for your gear, while 5 shotgun shell loops add extra convenience. Dual padded shoulder straps enhance comfort, with the right shoulder reinforced for weapon bracing.
description: Stay ready for action with Rothco’s Quick Draw Tactical Vest, designed for efficiency and comfort. The left-side universal pistol holder ensures a quick right-hand draw and accommodates most full-size handguns. 3 rifle magazine pouches and a triple pistol magazine pouch provide ample storage for your gear, while 5 shotgun shell loops add extra convenience. Dual padded shoulder straps enhance comfort, with the right shoulder reinforced for weapon bracing. The vest also features a hidden pocket for a spare cuff key, inside pouches for additional storage, and hook & loop back panels for ID attachments. Crafted from durable 600D polyester with breathable nylon mesh, this vest is built for rugged use. Adjustable sides and belt straps ensure a secure fit for most users.
